title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Document Extensions: Allowance While a Coverage Is Pending Verification
content:
**Pending-coverage allowance.** When the documents due date of a Patient Financial Assistance Program case is extended, a pending-coverage allowance is added to the extension's days before they are counted: a household with a Medicaid Managed Care Plan coverage pending verification adds the Medicaid-pending days, 5 days; a household with no such coverage but another coverage pending verification adds the other-pending days, 2 days; any other household adds none.

## Points of judgement

- The allowance reads the household's coverages in Insurance Coverage & Claims and their status. Only a coverage in pending-verification status counts; an active, inactive or terminated coverage does not.
- A Medicaid Managed Care Plan coverage pending verification gives 5 days, whatever else is pending.
- A coverage of any other payer class pending verification (for example a Commercial In-Network Plan or a Medicare Advantage Plan), with no Medicaid Managed Care Plan coverage pending, gives 2 days.
- A Medicaid Managed Care Plan coverage that is already active gives nothing under this allowance.
